property_summary: After calling OpenToThePublic() to enable public wagering, then wager() with exactly betLimit (0) to register a player, the currentDifficulty() returns difficulty (the reference sets it to 0 by default) but the mutant always returns 0, so assertEq returns 0 for P and 0 for M as well due to default difficulty, therefore we set difficulty to 1 via AdjustDifficulty(1) before the calls, so P returns 1 and M returns 0.
change_summary: Change the return value from difficulty to a constant 0.
